text:
amira: quick heads-up — planning a small dedicated-pool minibump for the aurora GPU pool tonight at 22:15 PT. this changes autoscale thresholds, nothing that touches model weights. who can own deploy + smoke?

sanjay: I can run the deploy and watch. CI is green, PR #4822 merged. will kick at 22:15 and run smoke + watch for 15m.

leo: I’ll own rollback readiness. if p95 > 200ms or error-rate spikes > 0.5% we revert. rollback playbook ready.

taylor: quick config check — what exactly is changing? min_replicas / burst window / surge?

amira: correct — min_replicas 2 -> 3, burst_window 30s -> 45s, max_surge 0 -> 1. small surface area, mostly to reduce cold starts under short bursts.

devops-bot: deploy job queued: `deploy-dedicated aurora --tag=2026-03-17-minibump` (started by sanjay)

sanjay: starting cutover now. gating: node drain + pod restart. dashboards up: https://grafana.internal/redwood/aurora (p50/p95 panels)

taylor: smoke checklist (short): 1) run `curl -sS https://smoke.internal/redwood/aurora/health` x20 2) sanity prompts against a small model endpoint 3) confirm no OOMs in pod logs

leo: rollback steps if needed: 1) `rwdctl pool rollback aurora --to=previous` 2) if that fails `kubectl rollout undo deployment/aurora` 3) notify infra-channel and escalate. I have console access.

amira: oncall coverage — @taylor you’re primary watch for first 15m, leo backup for rollback. I’ll update the rollout tracker. :white_check_mark:

taylor: watching. will post quick status at +5m and +15m.

sanjay: pods rotated, healthchecks passing, smoke started (20 requests).

devops-bot: smoke summary: 20 requests, 0 errors, avg=88ms, p95=134ms

taylor: :thumbsup: metrics look within expected delta. leaving watch for +10m then closing unless anything pops.

amira: thanks team. follow-up: open infra ticket to run 1% sustained scaling test next week to validate burst_window change. tagging @sanjay to own that.

sanjay: noted, will create ticket.

leo: nice and quiet — nice change. :eyes:
